text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While thinking about the training menu...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we give today's training 
our all as well~?
choice_data_list: It's not training time yet, is it?
It's not training time yet, is it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, you're right. Well, who cares, 
it's fine~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Strange. For a slacker like Seiun Sky, 
she's unusually serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what's wrong? Why do you have such a 
puzzled look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I bet you thought Sei-chan was 
plotting to slack off again, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Too bad. I couldn't come up with a single 
good idea today...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I feel so sluggish, my brain's just not 
working. Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky looked so exhausted that she 
didn't even have the energy to scheme a 
way out of training. Perhaps it's time to 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
